tasks.typecheck: deno check packages/core/mod.ts packages/mcp-bridge/mod.ts apps/control/main.ts apps/gateway/main.ts
tasks.test: deno task test:unit && deno task test:integration && deno task test:security
tasks.coverage: rm -rf .coverage && deno test --allow-read=. --allow-run=git --coverage=.coverage tests/unit tests/integration tests/security && deno coverage .coverage --detailed --threshold=70
tasks.security: deno task test:security && deno run --allow-read=. --allow-run=git scripts/security_check.ts
tasks.check: deno task fmt && deno task lint && deno task typecheck && deno task test && deno task security && deno task dependency-graph && deno task dependency-audit && deno task coverage
